proofs.text: Run `--gate recorded` and verify the output contains `.purlin/records/**`, `specs/**/*.approvals/*.ci.json` and `force push`; run `--gate tested` and verify it contains `force push` and not `.purlin/records/**`

reasons: PROOF-17 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: The branch rules the git host has to enforce are printed: under `tested` the force-push and deletion rule alone, and above it the restrictions on `.purlin/records/**` and the CI approval files as well

tests.body:
def test_the_branch_rules_are_printed(self, project):
        output = project.run('--gate', 'recorded')
        assert '.purlin/records/**' in output
        assert 'specs/**/*.approvals/*.ci.json' in output
        assert 'force push' in output.lower()
tests.name: test_tested_prints_only_the_force_push_rule
